title: My web app
summary: Build a working web app in HTML, CSS and JavaScript, then read, fix and trace code you didn't write. For OCR A Level Computer Science (H446) section 1.3.4.

briefs.name: Password checker
briefs.pitch: Score how strong a password is.

notes.6: checkPassword(pwd) returns a score: 1 point for 8 or more characters, 1 point if it contains a digit. So "hunter22" scores 2.
notes.7: Add a third point for a capital letter, found with a loop, so scores go 0 to 3. Keep the words in an array, ["Weak", "OK", "Good", "Strong"], and show the word for the score. Use a switch on the score to pick a tip.

briefs.name: Grade calculator
briefs.pitch: Turn an exam mark out of 100 into a grade.

notes.6: getGrade(mark) returns "Pass" when the mark is 40 or more, otherwise "Fail".
notes.7: Now return A* to E, or U below 40. Store the boundaries [90, 80, 70, 60, 50, 40] and grades ["A*", "A", "B", "C", "D", "E"] in two arrays and loop to find the first boundary the mark reaches. Use a switch on the grade to choose a message.

briefs.name: Café order
briefs.pitch: Work out what an order costs, in pence.

notes.6: orderCost(drink, qty) returns the cost in pence. A latte is 320p, so orderCost("latte", 2) is 640. Your form asks how many lattes: call orderCost("latte", value).
notes.7: Store the menu in two arrays: drinks ["tea", "coffee", "latte", "hot chocolate"] and prices [180, 250, 320, 300]. Loop to find the drink; a drink not on the menu costs 0. Use a switch on the quantity to show a message (e.g. case 0).

briefs.name: Unit converter
briefs.pitch: Convert distances and weights, using 8 km = 5 miles.

notes.6: convert(value, unit) converts km to miles (multiply by 5, divide by 8) and miles to km (multiply by 8, divide by 5). Your form converts km: call convert(value, "km").
notes.7: Use a switch on the unit for km, miles, m (to cm, × 100), cm (to m, ÷ 100) and kg (to g, × 1000). Return -1 for any other unit. Keep the five unit names in an array and loop through it to list them on the page.

form.onsubmit = function () { // given
  const value = form.{inputName}.value; // given

  return false; // given

challenges.title: Three languages
